opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip end-to-end
opportunities.description: For a given city, dates and party size: look up the city on Wikipedia, check weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com, find activities on Viator, find a dinner table on OpenTable, save a summary note, and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, notes app, mail app
steps: Search Wikipedia for {city} and open the city article; note the population
On timeanddate, search {city}, open its page and read the current weather
On Booking.com, set destination {city}, dates {checkin}-{checkout} and {adults} adults, search, and open the chosen hotel's Info & prices
On Viator, search for each '{activity} {city}' query and open the top result
On OpenTable, search '{city} {cuisine}', set the date to {checkin} and search, then open the chosen restaurant
In Notes, add the note '{city} {dates}: pop X, temp, hotel, activities, dinner {restaurant} 18:30'
In Mail, write to {friend_email} with subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a plan body, then send or discard

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, 2 adults, Thames boat + Tower of London, Indian -> Benares, maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, 3 adults, Guinness Storehouse + Cliffs of Moher (stopped before dinner/note/email)
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, 2 adults, whisky tasting + Highlands day trip, Scottish -> Evergreen Bar & Kitchen, priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Viator activity search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for a given activity query and open the top result's detail page.
steps: Click the 'Search for a place or activity' box
Select all and clear the existing text
Type '{activity query}'
Choose 'Search for {query}' (or a suggested option)
Open the first result card

instances.values: Thames boat London -> Westminster to Greenwich Thames Cruise
Tower of London London -> Tower of London and Crown Jewels Day Ticket
Guinness Storehouse Dublin -> Guinness Storehouse Experience
Cliffs of Moher Dublin -> Dublin to Cliffs of Moher, Wild Atlantic Way and Galway
whisky tasting Edinburgh -> Edinburgh Whisky Tasting and History on the Royal Mile
Highlands day trip Edinburgh -> Scottish Highlands, Loch Ness and Glencoe Day Trip

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for stays in a city for given dates and number of adults, then open a chosen property's prices.
steps: Clear the destination field and type {city}
Choose the matching city suggestion
Open the date picker and click {checkin} then {checkout}
Open the occupancy picker, set {adults} adults, click Done
Click Search
Open the chosen property and click 'Info & prices'

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, 2 adults -> voco London Camden Lock by IHG
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, 3 adults -> Maldron Hotel Smithfield Dublin City
Paris (abandoned at the date picker)
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, 2 adults -> Stylish Leith Residence Tram to Centre & Airport

opportunities.name: OpenTable dinner search
opportunities.description: Search OpenTable for a city and cuisine on a given date and open the top restaurant.
steps: Click the Location/Restaurant/Cuisine box and type '{city} {cuisine}'
Open the date selector, go to {date}'s month and click {date}
Click Let's go / Find a table
Open the first restaurant's details

instances.values: London Indian, Nov 13 2026 -> Benares
Edinburgh Scottish, Jan 15 2027 -> Evergreen Bar & Kitchen

opportunities.name: Email a trip plan to a friend
opportunities.description: Write an email to a friend with the subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a short plan body.
steps: Click To and type {email}
Click Subject and type '{city} weekend {dates}'
Click Body and type 'Hi {name}, plan: hotel ..., activities ..., dinner at ... on {date}.'
Click Send (both recorded runs clicked Discard)

instances.values: maya@example.com, London weekend Nov 13-Nov 15
priya@example.com, Edinburgh weekend Jan 15-Jan 17

opportunities.name: Save trip summary note
opportunities.description: Add one note line summarising a city trip: dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities and dinner.
steps: Click the 'New note' box
Type the summary '{city} {dates}: pop {pop}, {temp}, hotel {hotel} {price}, {activities}, dinner {restaurant} {time}'
Press Enter

instances.values: London Nov 13-Nov 15
Edinburgh Jan 15-Jan 17

opportunities.description: Search timeanddate for a city and open its current weather/forecast page.
steps: Click the city search box
Type {city}
Pick the matching result (from the suggestions or the search results list)
Open the Weather tab if it isn't already shown
